title: Before I begin… Ethics Moment
summary: An author reflects on ethical considerations when using AI tools in technology work, including concerns about training data consent, job displacement, and environmental impact. The post discusses balancing productivity gains against potential harms while committing to responsible AI use practices.
key_points: AI ethics encompasses multiple concerns: unconsenting data use in training, displacement of creative workers, and environmental costs from power and water consumption
The author acknowledges they cannot avoid using existing AI models but commits to raising industry pressure for better data collection practices and regulations
Ethical AI use involves sourcing creative elements responsibly, paying human creators, and prioritizing own writing over generative content
Productivity gains from efficient AI use can reduce overall environmental impact by eliminating unnecessary meetings and commutes

quotes.text: I can only do best by my kids, helping guide them (and by reflection, those are around them).
quotes.why_it_matters: Illustrates the author's philosophy of responsible stewardship when using powerful technologies, by analogy to parenting
